languages.name: Linguistics: the theory behind every guide
languages.script: Latin + IPA; examples in each language's own script
languages.notes: Not a language: a guide to linguistics itself (phonetics and IPA, phonology, morphology, syntax, semantics and pragmatics, typology, historical linguistics and reconstruction, writing systems, sociolinguistics, Leipzig glossing). Every example comes from a language in the atlas and links to that guide. Code qli is from ISO 639's local-use range (qaa–qtz), so it cannot clash with a real language. Written first after the pilot gate.
